Entered calibration directly in BYODA maybe 15-20 seconds before BYODA reads the BG from the transmitter. I got the double BGs in AAPS. 
![Screenshot_20220125-193145_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/151042531-f2947880-5742-4133-a6b8-7699d47d1fc8.jpg)

If it helps, the real timing was calibration followed by a "normal" reading but in AAPS, the order is reversed. "Normal" reading was registered first and the calibration BG was noted later.
